syncHelp.message: Sync reloads bookmarks in this Chrome profile so additions, renames, moves, and deletions appear in local search without calling the model.

settingsIntro.message: Type to search bookmarks locally. Once a model is configured, newly added bookmarks and bookmarks with changed titles or URLs are indexed automatically, and deleted bookmarks are cleaned up automatically. Existing bookmarks are indexed manually using the folders selected below; explicitly excluded folders also skip automatic indexing.

foldersHelp.message: Check a folder to include it and its subfolders. Restarting reuses existing summaries, including metadata-only summaries, and continues indexing remaining eligible pages.

privacyBody.message: Bookmark indexes, personal notes, and your API key are stored in this Chrome profile. Standard search runs locally. When calling a model, your API key is sent only as authentication to your configured gateway. AI Search sends your query text. Indexing sends bookmark titles, cleaned URLs, and available page excerpts. How the gateway routes or retains data depends on its provider. HTTPS is recommended for remote gateways.

previewHelp.message: Sample bookmark payload within your current selection. Indexing may include up to 2,400 characters of page excerpt. AI Search sends only your query. Your API key stays in this profile's extension storage.
